title: Bitirme Projesi (Sentetik Veri Üretim Sistemi)
summary: A Flask-based web application (final-year student project) that lets users upload real tabular datasets and generate synthetic data via model-based or random methods, then evaluates synthetic data quality with multiple metrics. It directly runs SDV's single-table synthesizers (CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN, GaussianCopula) and SDMetrics' quality/detection metrics to produce and score the synthetic output.
evidence: app.py:1214-2101 instantiates CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer, CopulaGANSynthesizer, GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with metadata objects; app.py:36-38 imports sdmetrics.single_table metrics
